## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
#guardamos
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
st_write(PERGAMINO,   "data/processed/pergamino_area.gpkg",    delete_dsn = TRUE)
st_write(calles_osm,  "data/processed/calles_osm_raw.gpkg",    delete_dsn = TRUE)
st_write(calles_line, "data/processed/calles_line.gpkg",       delete_dsn = TRUE)

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(calles_osm, "data/raw/calles_osm.rds")
saveRDS(calles_per, "data/processed/calles_per.rds")
saveRDS(calles_line, "data/processed/calles_line.rds")
saveRDS(calles_linered, "data/processed/calles_linered.rds")
saveRDS(calle_aux, "data/processed/calle_aux.rds")

calles_osm <- readRDS("data/raw/calles_osm.rds")

calles_per <- readRDS("data/processed/calles_per.rds")

calles_line <- readRDS("data/processed/calles_line.rds")

calles_linered <- readRDS("data/processed/calles_linered.rds")
```

```{r}
calles_line |>
  filter(name == "Ex-Ruta Nacional 8") |>
  select(osm_id, name, highway)
```

 

```{r}
calles_line |>
  filter(highway == "primary") |>
  count(name, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
ruta8 <- calles_line |>
  filter(name == "Ex-Ruta Nacional 8")

plot(st_geometry(ruta8), col = "red", lwd = 3)
```

 

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(calles_line),
     col = "grey70",
     lwd = 1)

plot(st_geometry(ruta8),
     col = "red",
     lwd = 3,
     add = TRUE)
```

```{r}
calles_line |>
  filter(name %in% c("Ex-Ruta Nacional 8",
                     "Avenida Malvinas Argentinas")) |>
  select(osm_id, name, highway, geometry)
```

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(calles_line),
     col = "grey80",
     lwd = 1)

plot(st_geometry(
  calles_line |>
    filter(name %in% c("Ex-Ruta Nacional 8",
                       "Avenida Malvinas Argentinas"))
),
col = "red",
lwd = 3,
add = TRUE)
```

```{r}
malvinas <- calles_line |>
  filter(name == "Avenida Malvinas Argentinas")

ruta8 <- calles_line |>
  filter(name == "Ex-Ruta Nacional 8")

plot(st_geometry(malvinas),
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 3)

plot(st_geometry(ruta8),
     col = "red",
     lwd = 3,
     add = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(malvinas),
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 3)

plot(st_geometry(ruta8),
     col = "red",
     lwd = 3,
     add = TRUE)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Avenida Malvinas Argentinas",
                  "Ex-Ruta Nacional 8"),
       col = c("blue", "red"),
       lwd = 3)
```

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(ruta8),
     col = "red",
     lwd = 4)
```

```{r}
st_bbox(ruta8)
st_bbox(malvinas)
```

```{r}
st_distance(
  st_geometry(ruta8),
  st_geometry(malvinas)
) |>
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
PERGAMINO_5347 <- st_transform(PERGAMINO, 5347)

st_intersects(
  ruta8,
  PERGAMINO_5347,
  sparse = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
head(st_coordinates(calles_line), 10)

head(st_coordinates(calles_linered), 10)
```

```{r}
max(abs(
  st_coordinates(calles_line)[, 1:2] -
    st_coordinates(calles_linered)[, 1:2]
))
```
